text:
jamie: Heads-up from QA: compact tables with selection checkboxes feel cramped. the checkbox hit area overlaps the row action when density token is set to "compact".

ori: saw that too — reproduces on the model list when you enable compact density. the checkbox visual is 16px with 4px padding. touch target below WCAG.

frank: can we keep compact visuals but expand interactive region? same idea as other components: visual 16px, hit area 44px. also the ghost button in the row (more actions) loses its focus ring in high-contrast mode.

anya: ui suggestion: introduce a semantic token `--table-dense-checkbox-gap` and set a default safe margin so the checkbox never overlaps the action column. e.g. default 12px.

jamie: agree. and add `pointer-events:none` to the decorative spacer so clicks land on the checkbox, not the row link.

ori: CSS sketch:
```css
.table--compact .row-checkbox { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.table--compact .row-checkbox .box { width:16px; height:16px; }
.table--compact { --table-dense-checkbox-gap: 12px; }
.row-actions { margin-left: var(--table-dense-checkbox-gap); }
.row-actions .ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }
```

frank: also suggest changing the ghost button hover fill from `neutral-8` to `neutral-7` in dark theme; current hover reads too bright.

anya: accessibility follow-up: add `aria-label` to the checkbox like `Select row for bulk actions` and ensure screenreader announces row id/primary cell. Also ensure keyboard users can tab into the checkbox rather than skipping because of wrapping links.

jamie: good call. QA will re-run with VoiceOver + NVDA once PR is up.

frank: I'll PR the CSS tokens + fix focus-visible tests.

design-bot: Task created: COMPONENTS-550 "table: compact checkbox hit target, density token, ghost focus fix, a11y labels" Milestone 2.20.0

jamie: thanks team. resolving after PR review.
